pr_title: WebXRManager: add undefined check in onSessionEnd()
pr_body:
This commit adds a undefined check prior to disconnecting the controller in `onSessionEnd()` as described in https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/issues/23983

Fixed #23983 

**Description**

Lack of undefined check for controllers in onSessionEnd causes errors if getController is never called. Undefined check prevents errors

<!-- Remove the line below if is not relevant -->

issue_context.title: WebXRManager throws error in onSessionEnd if getController is never called
issue_context.body:
TLDR: Lack of null check for controllers in `onSessionEnd` causes errors if `getController` is never called

It seems controllers are only created when `getController` or `getControllerGrip` are called. if those functions are never called, we end up with null controllers in the inputSourcesMap

https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/1238a324e081752d9f66219252361f05f73594df/src/renderers/webxr/WebXRManager.js#L337-L344

Once the session ends, there's no null check for the controllers when trying to disconnect them as seen below

https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/1238a324e081752d9f66219252361f05f73594df/src/renderers/webxr/WebXRManager.js#L132-L138

review_comments:
Is this the check you want to do?

```js
if ( controller !== null ) {
```

I think it's: 
```js
if ( controller !== undefined ) {
```
If we want to make the check more explicit like above, we should also update `onSessionEvent()`.
Ah, I was confused because "This commit adds a null check prior to disconnecting".
Yes, we should definitely be as explicit as possible 👍
@Mugen87 Feel free to merge and do the `onSessionEvent()` clean up too 🙏
Ah apologies, null/undefined feel the same to me in many cases, but I get there's a difference. Thanks for updating the title and merging this through!
